sources.metadata_provenance: Original download metadata not re-obtained; prior response body re-read from registered asset. Prior supplied report describes HTTP 200.

official_mechanisms.claim: Nonempty matches identifies existing names and IDs in the Official CPE Dictionary; cpeLastModified is when matches values were last updated.
CPE matchCriteriaId parameter returns all dictionary records associated with the specified UUID.
CVE configuration UUID can be used by Match Criteria and CPE API.
Match date filtering compares the most recent lastModified or cpeLastModified; relevant dictionary creation, modification and deprecation update cpeLastModified.

reference_observation.semantics: Current public records in the authorized bounded window; no September 9 historical snapshot is claimed.

stability.interpretation: Construction-window stability is supported by full current CVE equality and the complete official Match revision index, whose documented fields cover status and relevant dictionary-name changes. This is not a historical replay, a proof excluding all transient changes, or certification of later blind evaluations.
